EVE Online – 21 Jul 26

Monthly Ban Report- June 2026 | EVE Online

The Monthly Ban Report for June 2026.

* Bans by Alliance - This has been made public in the past and is often requested in the comments associated with our social media posts. It’s not something that we will be publishing for the simple reason that we don’t care what alliance or corporation a player belongs to. If they violate the EULA, they get punished, no matter what colors they fly under.

I think we’d all like to see who the worst offenders are by alliance and language. Let the chips fall where they may…

Interesting to note that there’s very few offences being committed by characters over 100 million SP…

Sure they are sheltered and encouraged by alliances, but I doubt the CCP Banning Team would care much… at least some should have been caught, because in some scenarios it’s just very obvious.

Talking about bots got ganked or for some other reason are no longer in the mining ship but keep warping between station and belt for hours. Impossible to explain that this is a real human.

posts.name: Arthur Aihaken
posts.cooked:
They indicated that they “used to” (however far back or where that was, I certainly don’t remember or recall it), but that it wasn’t important. Whenever someone tells you a data point isn’t important - it usually is.

Either it’s one particular alliance that’s the worst offender - or it’s a bunch of them. It’s probably both, ie: one particular alliance that’s sheltering the most macro users but that most of the major alliances all have their “gold farming” wing. It’s easy to say Imperium is the worst being the largest, but on a % basis they may be the lowest offender.

In terms of language, it’s almost certainly Chinese/Russian leading the top 2 (or maybe even tied for #1). I’d be really surprised if Australia, Europe, the United States or even Canada were the worst offenders (or even in the top 3). Who knows - maybe it’s Greenland…

My guess is that the US is probably the worst offender for credit card chargebacks, China and/or Russia is the worst for macro use and automated signups, Russia is the worst for ISK selling and the US is almost certainly the worst for ISK buying.
